item.title: Live HN Project Show and Tell on "Fediverse" – Happening NYOW
item.summary: THAT'S A WRAP - THANK YOU! We are experimenting with broadcasting using OBS (screen streaming tool) and MakerTube (PeerTube P2P video platform) - sort of a current day "Waynes World". To test out the setup, we are doing a low-key tech show & tell. Also, it's sort of a chill "water cooler" to chat with some interesting people. Important links: (1) The Live video feed: (MAKERTUBE): https://makertube.net/w/nbGPYcUfLKxDtLb5KMKWHn (2) The Zoom call-in / discussion (ZOOM): https://us05web.zoom.us/j/83078639517?pwd=MCaBOWiQuanRPQ7AeMdYgzXEF5SX9p.1 Let's see how it goes! PS Nerd details: Reporting live from Medellin Colombia, using Linux Mint Debian Edition + OBS, which is streaming to MakerTube/PeerTube.
